tasks.title: Announcement #30
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement on a campus radio station.
tasks.transcript: Man: Due to some recent changes in university policy, we need everyone to update their contact information in the student portal. Doing so will ensure that you receive important notifications, including about class cancellations and emergency alerts. Please complete the update by the end of this week. Don't take a chance on missing out on critical information.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention class cancellations and emergency alerts?

options.A: To inform students about recent policy changes
options.B: To emphasize the importance of updating contact information
options.C: To promote a new program on personal health
options.D: To point out that classes are often canceled because of bad weather

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问说话者为什么提到课程取消和紧急警报，属于组织结构/功能题，需理解这些内容在上下文中的作用。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 说话者提到课程取消和紧急警报是为了说明更新联系方式的重要性，而非告知政策变化本身。 选项B：正确。 说话者说更新联系方式可以确保收到重要通知，包括课程取消和紧急警报，列举这些例子是为了强调更新联系方式的重要性。 选项C：错误。 通知中没有提到个人健康方面的项目，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 通知中没有讨论课程取消的原因，只是举例说明可能错过的重要信息类型。

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply when he says, "Don't take a chance on missing out on critical information"?

options.C: The portal can be difficult to navigate.
options.D: Important information has just been posted.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问说话者说“Don't take a chance on missing out on critical information”时暗示了什么，属于推断题，需结合上下文理解这句话的言外之意。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 说话者前面要求在本周末前完成更新，并说不要冒险错过重要信息，暗示学生应该尽快完成更新。 选项B：错误。 通知中讨论的是更新联系方式以接收通知，而非课堂出勤要求，属于概念混淆。 选项C：错误。 通知中没有提到门户网站难以操作，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 通知中强调更新联系方式是为了接收未来的通知，并未说明重要信息刚刚发布，属于过度推断。
